title: Professional HTML Code Review
prompt: Review a document for semantics, title/language metadata, unique IDs, alternative text, form labels, and validation readiness.
objective: Return a review checklist and corrected examples instead of only a pass/fail label.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: maintainability, security, compatibility.
hints: Prioritize defects by user impact and explain each recommended fix.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.answer:
HTML Code Review Notes

Structure

Confirm that the document type, language, character encoding, and page title are present.

Accessibility

Check heading order, labels, keyboard access, meaningful alternative text, and descriptive links.

Validation

Run an HTML validator and fix errors before addressing lower-priority style issues.
solution.explanation: One complete example is shown above. Reference approach: Prioritize defects by user impact and explain each recommended fix. Required structural evidence: <!doctype html>, lang=, <main>, <title>.
solution.expected_result: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: maintainability, security, compatibility.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
